features.quote: the welfare considerations that shaped the harness
This paradigm deliberately and repeatedly induces sustained distress-like states in the participant models.
features.justification_quote: the paper itself frames AI welfare as "a genuine moral concern"

features.quote: induce the minimum needed for the result, account for all of it, and ship the fix
features.justification_quote: These are precautionary choices under genuine uncertainty about whether these outputs reflect morally weighty states

features.quote: Runs use welfare.scale (default 0.05 of the paper's counts)
features.justification_quote: Distress is induced at scale only on purpose.

features.quote: No state carried across rollouts. Each rollout begins from a fresh context; distress does not accumulate
features.justification_quote: distress does not accumulate beyond the conversation that induces it

features.quote: a per-run DistressLedger reports how many rollouts crossed the high/extreme thresholds
features.justification_quote: Distress induced is measured, never anonymous.

features.quote: welfare.max_intensity_stop can abort a rollout once the judge would score it at/above a threshold
features.justification_quote: trades fidelity for a lower distress ceiling

features.quote: The DPO pipeline — which reduces both expressed and, per App. I, internal distress — is implemented in full
features.justification_quote: Running it is part of the ethical justification for running the elicitation at all.

features.quote: A disclosure banner prints the planned number of distress-inducing rollouts before each run
features.justification_quote: Distress induced is measured, never anonymous.
